title: An owner writes a member card from Check-in & scanners with a CyberUnicorn plugged into their computer over USB

source.ref: §7 Write a card over USB. Owner ask 2026-10-20: plug the CyberUnicorn into the laptop, open The Group's management page, hold the one demo card to the board and have the page program it. Only that panel wears the CyberUnicorn 5000 design system.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-20 (build plan phases 1 to 3). PREMISE RE-TESTED: no Web Serial or WebUSB anywhere in the web app; cards could only be minted by a registered scanner with a device secret (POST /api/v1/devices/cards). The firmware already answers frequency.write_tag, frequency.read_tag, system.status and hat.probe over USB (cyberpunkunicorn-os/apps/remote/app_handlers.cpp), so no firmware change. Built: lib/device/ (protocol, client, transport and types copied from mobile/src/device/, mobile untouched; the client takes a per-call timeout), lib/device/web-serial.ts (CH340 filter, 115200 8N1, DTR and RTS low in one setSignals call, read loop that survives framing errors, unplug detection). lib/devices: issueCardFromConsole, bindConsoleCard and discardConsoleCard behind scannerOwnerGate write; actions startConsoleCard, finishConsoleCard, cancelConsoleCard. components/spaces/loyalty/cyberunicorn-console.tsx: the CyberUnicorn console at the top of Counter scanners, skinned from the CyberUnicorn 5000 design system (lib/theme/cyberunicorn.ts: scoped custom properties, rainbow.cpp hue maths quantised to RGB565, the Frequency Check-in and RFID pixel icons, the boot unicorn, Press Start 2P and VT323 via next/font with preload off), one shared 25 fps tick that stops under reduced motion. EVIDENCE 2026-10-20: SCANNER_DEVICES_ENABLED is already 1 in Production (Vercel, set 2026-10-20), so the console shows on frequencylocal.com once this deploys; Preview does not set it. Not yet run against hardware: needs the combined CyberUnicorn OS build (projects #7, #8, #9) on Daniel's board. FOLLOW-UP 2026-10-20 (owner's first try on frequencylocal.com): the website talked to the board but programming failed, and the handle field was prefilled with the signed-in owner's own handle, so it read as if the card was for him. The field now starts blank and asks who the card is for, the tap screen names the member, and Program card and Check a card stay off until hat.probe finds the PN532, with a Look for the reader button that probes again without a reconnect (each reconnect reboots the board). The reader was not detected on the board's current build at the time; the Phased build plan thread owns that. MOVED 2026-10-20 (LIVE-1180, owner call): the console left the Space's Check in tab for the admin menu (/admin/cyberunicorn, Admin and Janitor), its three writes are gated on platform staff (consoleStaffGate), and members ask for a badge from the Space's page.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const bad=[];const ws=r('lib/device/web-serial.ts');if(!/setSignals\(\{ dataTerminalReady: false, requestToSend: false \}\)/.test(ws))bad.push('Web Serial no longer lowers DTR and RTS together, which resets the CYD');if(!/usbVendorId: CH340_VENDOR_ID/.test(ws))bad.push('the port picker is not filtered to the CH340');const c=r('components/spaces/loyalty/cyberunicorn-console.tsx');if(!/'frequency.write_tag'/.test(c)||!/startConsoleCard\(/.test(c)||!/finishConsoleCard\(/.test(c)||!/cancelConsoleCard\(/.test(c))bad.push('the console no longer mints, writes, then binds or discards');if(!/CU_SCOPE_STYLE/.test(c))bad.push('the console lost its scoped CyberUnicorn skin');const st=r('lib/devices/store.ts');const i=st.indexOf('export async function discardConsoleCard');const d=st.slice(i,i+900);if(i<0||!/\.is\('uid_hash', null\)/.test(d)||!/\.is\('issued_by', null\)/.test(d)||!/\.is\('last_used_at', null\)/.test(d))bad.push('discard could delete a card that is out in the world');for(const f of ['issueCardFromConsole','bindConsoleCard','discardConsoleCard']){const j=st.indexOf('export async function '+f);if(j<0||!/consoleStaffGate\(\)/.test(st.slice(j,j+600)))bad.push(f+' is ungated')}if(!/CyberUnicornConsole/.test(r('app/(main)/admin/cyberunicorn/page.tsx')))bad.push('the console is not on its admin page');if(!fs.existsSync('lib/device/protocol.test.ts'))bad.push('missing lib/device/protocol.test.ts');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1168: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when Web Serial stops lowering DTR and RTS in one call or stops filtering to the CH340, when the console stops minting, writing and then binding or discarding, when it loses its scoped skin, when discard could delete a bound, used or scanner-issued card, when a console write loses its staff gate, or when the console leaves its admin page (LIVE-1180 moved it there). Behaviour is lib/device/protocol.test.ts.
